reason: I already pay for a booking engine and a channel manager, and they take bookings and send confirmations. I don't see what a guest app and a WhatsApp bot add that I can't do myself on my phone at midnight.
objection: I already pay for a booking engine or channel manager. Another system to set up, pay for and keep running sounds like more work for me, not less, and a designer's 'from $800' is only the start of the bill.
would_change_my_mind: Proof, in numbers from a property like mine, that direct bookings rise enough to cover the full cost, with the setup done by someone who stays on to fix it.
